target.text: Blion reported ticket 2214 at lunchtime; the west stairwell door jams whenever the latch is wet. Maintenance will bring a new closer kit Thursday.

Customer Raizner could not sign in to the tenant portal this morning, even after a password reset. Support verified the mailbox alias and reopened case 8830 for the identity team. A callback is booked for tomorrow.

Stathis Nahvi-Djoo raised ticket 5520 because the parcel room camera keeps losing its feed overnight. Building services swapped the power adapter but the fault returned within two days. A replacement unit is on order, and the tenant has been told to expect a visit next Monday.
Hascoet Cameira flagged the broken buzzer on flat 9 this morning. The panel lights up but nobody rings through, so deliveries keep piling at the entrance.

Edrian sent ticket 6612 after the kitchen extractor started rattling above the fryers. Nobody wants to work that station while the noise continues. An engineer is due Friday morning with a spare motor and mounting bolts.

Resident Laver opened case 4193 about the gym ceiling leak that keeps soaking the mats near the squat rack. Staff roped off the area and placed two buckets beneath the worst drip. Roofers will inspect the membrane once the rain stops, probably Thursday, with scaffolding ready.
De Boo filed ticket 7791: the loading dock roller shutter will not close fully, leaving a hand-width gap overnight. Security wants a same-week repair.

Lolo Annalyn Oliapuram reported the north lift stopping between floors twice before breakfast. The alarm worked, but the doors stayed shut for several minutes each time. A technician has been booked and residents were emailed.

Donny logged ticket 3388 about the persistent damp patch spreading across the archive room wall. Files stored on the lower shelves have started to curl at the corners, which nobody noticed until this week. Dehumidifiers are running now, and the wall will be opened up to trace the pipe.
Dr. Canossi raised ticket 9021: the consultation room thermostat reads six degrees higher than the corridor sensor. Patients keep asking for fans during appointments.

von Ostheim opened case 4477 after the courtyard gate code stopped working for the whole east block. Two couriers were stuck outside for twenty minutes yesterday. A locksmith will reprogram the keypad and issue fresh codes.

Mayada Medrado reported ticket 6150 about the broken step at the south entrance, which has already caused one twisted ankle. The concrete crumbled after last month's frost, and the handrail wobbles as well. A mason is scheduled for Wednesday, weather permitting, with temporary tape up until then.
Priore from unit 214 filed ticket 7788 about the intercom buzzing all night. The panel was reset twice, and the noise came back within an hour.

Sevdush, the courier form you sent this morning is missing the depot stamp, so the carrier rejected the whole batch. Could you resend it with the stamp and reference 55-204? The afternoon pickup leaves at four.
Thanks,
Dispatch Desk

Dr. Plader, your referral packet reached our clinic yesterday, but page three is blank on both copies. Could you have the records office refax the missing section to 555-0119 before Friday? We cannot schedule the scan without it. The patient has been offered a provisional slot on the fifteenth.
Regards,
Clinic Front Desk

Raymund Kapor, the venue has moved tonight's rehearsal to the upper hall because of the floor works. Doors open at six. Please tell the choir.
Thanks,
Hall Office

Yaowaluck Ohl, your expense claim 88-341 has been returned because the taxi receipt is dated before the trip began. Please attach the correct slip or add a note explaining the mismatch. Approvals close Thursday at noon.
Best,
Payroll

Xhihan, thanks for covering the late desk shift on such short notice. Two things before you lock up: the back door needs the deadbolt as well as the latch, and the parcel trolley must go inside the cage. The alarm code changed last week; please check the new card. I owe you a coffee.
Cheers,
Front Desk

Ms. Hendricks, the print room queue is stuck on your thesis file again. Please collect the pages before five, or they will be recycled.
Thanks,
Library Desk

Zeïn Elicio Nsakala, your locker deposit refund was processed on Tuesday and should appear within three working days. If the amount looks wrong, reply with the original receipt number. Accounts can amend it quickly.
Regards,
Accounts Team

Giclat Campioni Reedy, the catering quote for the spring dinner finally arrived, and it is about a fifth over the budget we agreed. I have asked them to split the drinks from the food so we can compare. Your thoughts before the committee meets on Monday would help.
Best,
Events Office

Yayesh, the printer on level two is eating envelopes again. Can you log it before the mail run at three?
Regards,
Ops Room

Dr. Verzaro, the second ultrasound appointment has been moved to the Riverside annex because the main scanner is being serviced. Parking there is free for patients. Please arrive fifteen minutes early with the referral letter.
Regards,
Imaging Desk

Iker Achille, the membership renewal failed because the card on file expired in March. We have held your booking until Friday. To keep the same slot, update the payment details in the portal or call the club. After Friday, the lane goes back to the waiting list.
Best,
Club Office

Joos Vinayagamoorthy Popprath, the archive key still has not come back from your department. Could you check the drawer by the copier?
Thanks,
Records Team

Mr. Barkate, your seat on the Thursday coach has been moved to the front because of the motion sickness note on your booking. The driver has the updated list. Boarding starts at half past six.
Regards,
Travel Desk

Ticket 3340 came in just before seven: the pool cover winch jammed halfway, so the pool stayed closed all morning. Liam traced the fault to a frayed cable and taped off the area. A replacement cable arrives tomorrow, and the morning swim session is cancelled again.
Case 7810: the vending machine on floor three swallowed two notes and then went dark. Facilities called Dikenmann, who services the unit and knows the reset procedure.

Ticket 2299 concerns the squealing belt in the laundry room dryer, which maintenance ignored twice. Misrak Perré finally recorded a clip, and the repair was escalated this morning. Parts should arrive by the weekend.

Report 5602 is about the noise from the rooftop plant, which now runs past midnight. Neighbours on the top floor have complained three times this month. Malia Anna-Maria measured the levels on Tuesday and agreed they exceed the lease terms. A sound engineer is being asked to quote.
The cafeteria fridge has been warm since Monday, and nobody logged it properly. Pascal-Olivier noticed the milk turning and put in request 4471 today.
Ticket 9127: the lift phone connects to an empty office after six. Residents pressing the button hear nothing but static. Romanca from the security desk tested it twice and raised the fault priority.

Case 6713 was opened after the parcel shelf in the mailroom collapsed for the second time this quarter. Boxes spilled across the corridor, and one courier nearly tripped. Jaïda Vasilia reinforced the bracket on a temporary basis and ordered a steel replacement, promising a permanent fix by the month's end.
The stairwell sensor light flickers all night and wakes the ground-floor flats. Yihao Farai Molcanová has asked for ticket 2216 to cover a full sensor swap.

The delivery bay drain backs up whenever it rains hard, and the smell reaches reception. Philiberta reported it last Thursday, then again on Monday when the water spread. A drain crew is booked for the weekend.

Ticket 4880 tracks the recurring power cuts in the east wing, now happening most mornings between nine and ten. The backups hold, but the lifts reset each time. Cacic from building control suspects a failing breaker and has scheduled a full inspection, with a temporary generator on standby for next week.
The smoke detector in the study room chirps every few minutes and distracts everyone. Bartholomew Celeste swapped the battery, yet ticket 5503 stays open because the chirp returned.

Case 3301: the garden irrigation timer runs at midnight and floods the path by the bins. Two residents slipped before anyone connected the noise to the schedule. Minh Espelleta adjusted the valve and will replace the controller next week.

Subject: Rehearsal room booking for the winter concert. The hall you requested is already taken on the ninth, so I penciled you into the annex instead. Siobhan, could you confirm the piano is tuned before the first session? If the annex is unsuitable, ring the office and we can shuffle the slots.
Regards,
Music Office

The quote for the roof repair came in higher than we discussed. Ms. Taraki has asked for a breakdown before the board meets.
Best,
Estates

Thanks for sending the revised schedule. One clash remains: Almina Neissa is booked for two rooms at the same hour on Thursday. Please move the smaller session. Everything else works.
Thanks,
Scheduling

Subject: Fire drill feedback. The marshals cleared the east wing in four minutes, which is our best time this year. Tya Shia noted that two stairwell doors were propped open and has asked for signage. Could each floor lead confirm their roll call by Friday?
Regards,
Safety Office

Quick stocktake update: the south aisle is done, Emily counted the whole bay alone. Start the north side after lunch with the new scanners.
— Floor Ops

Thanks for the meter readings. Two flats still show unusual usage, and Dr. Csáti wants those checked before the billing run. Could your team revisit on Tuesday morning with the portable logger?
Regards,
Billing

Subject: Storage room clear-out. The old files are going to the shredder on the twenty-eighth, so anything you want kept must be moved to the cage before then. Munib Luciene will label the shelves on Friday. Anything left after that gets collected without warning.
Regards,
Facilities

The handover notes are in the blue folder. Shorsh Gjemali added the spare key codes and flagged the faulty light on level one.
Cheers,
Night Desk

Your visitor pass for Thursday is ready at the front desk. Kenan will meet you in the lobby around ten and walk you through the site rules. Bring photo identification.
Regards,
Reception

The annual safety walk happens next Wednesday, and this year the route includes the roof plant. Warden Fouassier has agreed to lead the group and will bring the harnesses. Please wear flat shoes and arrive ten minutes before eight. Sign the sheet at reception.
Best,
Site Office

Delivery confirmed for Thursday between eight and ten. Insa Niman will sign for the pallets if the lab is still locked. Leave the invoice on the bench.
Thanks,
Goods In

Following the water test, the kitchen taps are clear to use again. Results will be logged here once de Vaan has retested on Monday and checked the final sample. Until then, bottled water stays available in the corridor.
Regards,
Estates

Fwd: Bike rack
Three racks were removed for welding. Prasanna flagged the missing bolts. Reinstall is booked for Friday afternoon.

Forwarded from Security Desk
Subject: Door access
A temporary badge was issued for the loading bay while the reader is replaced. Veksler will collect the old one once the audit finishes. Until then, visitors must sign in at reception.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Procurement
Subject: Sample approvals
Two suppliers sent updated fabric samples, and both arrived creased. Quinto Gippner Sliz compared them against the approved swatch and recommends rejecting the heavier weave. A third sample is due before the order closes next month. Please reply with your preference.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Finance
Subject: Petty cash
Campara Colthof signed off the receipts from the site visit. The tin needs another float before Friday.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Site Office
Subject: Generator service
The weekly generator check was skipped twice. Ezatollah ran the full test this morning and found the oil level low. The service crew has been asked to come Wednesday instead of next month.

Fwd: Incident follow-up (from Compliance)
The visitor log for last week has gaps on two afternoons, and nobody can explain them. Krylov reviewed the camera timestamps and matched both gaps to a badge reader fault. A written note is now required at the desk whenever the system drops out. Training starts Monday.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Lab Desk
Subject: Freezer alarm
Roswitta Senoussi heard the alarm reset itself overnight, so the log may be wrong. Please check the panel history.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Events
Subject: Marquee deposit
The marquee company wants half the fee before they confirm the date. Davey Inverneiro checked the budget line and says we can cover it this quarter. Approval is needed by Thursday or the slot goes.

Ward Clerk — forwarded notes
Three discharge summaries went out with the wrong follow-up dates, and the clinic has started calling us. Raeto checked the template and found an old calendar embedded in the footer. A corrected version was sent before noon, and the affected patients were called. A review of last month's batch is underway.

Fwd: Lost umbrella
A grey umbrella was left in the lobby on Tuesday. Lee thinks it belongs to the courier who signs for parcels.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Training
Subject: First aid renewal
Two certificates expire at the end of the month, and the refresher course is nearly full. Keip Persiaux reserved the last two places this morning. Payment must clear before the course provider confirms the booking.

Audit Desk: forwarding the stock count queries
Four lines in the quarterly count still have no owner, and the deadline is Friday. Radmanovic Kuckelsberg Ssemuwemba traced two of them to a moved aisle and will recheck the labels tomorrow. The remaining pair sits with the night team, who were emailed late yesterday. Answers are expected before the audit meeting.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Housing Office
Subject: Key return
Keys came back without tags, so Castorina will relabel the cupboard on Monday and set aside the spares.

Community hall meeting, 12 March
Present: six residents, two staff
Item one: the boiler survey quote came in at four thousand. Nodar asked whether the repair could wait until autumn, and the room agreed to get a second quote.

Minutes, roof committee
Present: estates, two contractors
The membrane survey found three soft spots above the stairwell. Schorling advised a full strip rather than patch repairs, quoting similar costs over ten years. The committee asked for a phased plan and agreed to revisit the budget in April. No decision until then.

Toolbox talk, bay four, morning shift
Seven fitters attended.
Hivin Vallet Cambera raised the cable ramp that keeps slipping near the spray booth. A new mat is ordered.

Tenant forum, 7 February
Nine people came.
Parking dominated again: two vans block the turning circle every evening. Sabija Sinthu suggested numbered bays and offered to draft a map. The idea was accepted in principle, and a copy will go up in the lobby.

Safety committee, 21 March
Present: warden, two technicians, one visitor
The warden reported that the loosened handrail by the north gate was repaired on Tuesday. Thinesh suggested a monthly walk-through and volunteered for the first inspection. The group also discussed better lighting near the bike shelter, though no budget was assigned. Next meeting is in May.

Budget review, second quarter
Five cost lines were cut.
Dunkelberg questioned the training figure, which doubled without explanation. Finance will reply by email before the next round.

Ward handover, night shift
One isolation room occupied, two discharges pending.
Tan Renée flagged that two call bells in the east corridor are slow to answer and asked for the electrician to be called today. The linen order arrived short again.

Programme meeting, week 12
Six tasks open, two overdue.
The warehouse shelving order is delayed by customs, which pushes the fit-out to May. Antonenko Hepberger Bajda proposed splitting the delivery so the east bay can open on time. The client agreed to review the revised dates and will confirm by Friday. Costs stay inside the contingency.
Staff briefing this morning: both fryers are down. Divja raised the missing thermometer in the walk-in and asked for a replacement before the weekend rush. The order list was updated.

Library committee, 4 April
Eight members present.
The quiet room booking system keeps double-booking study desks at weekends. Niethammer from IT explained the sync delay and promised a patch by the end of the month. Members agreed to report clashes through the form until then.

Joint estates meeting, 9 May
Present: both landlords, one surveyor
The shared drain camera survey found tree roots at the boundary, and neither side wants to pay first. Durs Solyana offered to split the excavation cost if the work happens before July. Both parties accepted, and a contractor will quote next week. The minutes were circulated the same evening.
Gate review cancelled today; only two of five leads joined. Cugura Mahfar Pilan moved the decision to Thursday and asked each lead to send written notes first.

Parking working group, 18 June
Four spaces remain unallocated.
The bays behind the workshop flood whenever the drain blocks, so they stay empty. Stehmann proposed raising them with a gravel platform and will price the job. The group agreed to decide after the summer.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Front Desk
Subject: Parcel room overflow
Three pallets of brochures arrived early and are blocking the walkway to the loading bay. We stacked what we could in the cage, but the rest is still on the floor. A second drop comes tomorrow morning. If nobody claims them by noon, they go to storage. Kamar
The lift maintenance report is below. Nothing urgent, but the door sensor is drifting and will be replaced at the next visit. Any access changes should reach Essabbai before Friday.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Payroll
Subject: Timesheet corrections
Two overtime claims were entered against the wrong cost code, which delayed the run. The sheets were resent and the difference is small. Please confirm the fix landed, and thank El Euchi for catching it.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Facilities
Subject: Kitchen deep clean
The extractor hoods are booked for stripping on the 29th, which means the main kitchen closes at two. Cold prep can continue in the annex if the fridges are moved first. Catering has been told and will post signs on the doors. Any concerns should reach Orijana Inoué.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Stores
Subject: Gloves
The medium nitrile gloves are down to the last box. Keep the spare carton for the night crew and ask Fedor.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: IT Support
Subject: Printer queue
The label printer on the mezzanine keeps dropping from the network after about an hour and jobs vanish from the queue. The driver update is scheduled for Thursday evening and Karaman will test it Friday.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Dispatch
Subject: Van allocation
The blue van is going in for its service on Tuesday, which leaves two vehicles for four routes. The early runs take priority, so the late routes will share the hire car. Bookings for Wednesday should move to Thursday. Any conflicts go to Mescuso Verest, who is covering dispatch this week.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Lab
Subject: Incubator log
The incubator log has a gap from Sunday. Samples in tray four may be affected. Hold them and tell Crisanta Sholpan.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Scheduling
Subject: Room swaps
The training room is double-booked on Thursday, and the smaller group has a guest speaker coming. I have moved the induction session to the annex. Please update signage and let Ilmira handle the visitor passes.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Accounts
Subject: Refund backlog
The refund queue grew this week because the card terminal rejects partial reversals after five. Two batches were reprocessed manually, and the rest are waiting on the vendor patch. Until that lands, all partial refunds must be split into full reversals and fresh charges. Escalate anything unusual to Jungmichel.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Reception
Subject: Visitor badge
The new visitor badges arrived without clips, so they cannot be worn. de Lillo will bring clips from the supply room.

Fwd: Slip near bay two
An oil patch by bay two caused a near miss during the shift change. The absorbent granules were empty again. Signage goes up today, and Serafin Rzic Picamilho is tracking the fix.

Rota planning, 14 March
Six gaps remain for the holiday weeks, mostly on the weekend shifts. The rota board is up to date, but two slots are penciled in without confirmation. Agency cover is being priced as a fallback, and the draft will be shared tomorrow. Any swaps must be requested in writing from now on. Ivica

Stores review, 2 April
Four small tools are missing from the shelves. The cage lock is being replaced next week, and the missing items were reordered today by Leko.

Housekeeping huddle, 11 May
Two floors are short of linen again, so the laundry is running a second evening cycle. The contractor will deliver on Wednesday. Rooms on the third floor take priority this week. Bring any shortages to Bajrush Hedayat.

Production review, week 15
Three lines ran under target, and the packaging order is two days late. Maintenance blamed a sensor fault on line two, which was cleaned on Friday. The schedule for next week has been rebuilt around the late delivery. Overtime is approved for Thursday only. Any further delays should be reported to Gian-Paul Rover Masciarelli.

Ward round notes, Friday
Three discharges are planned before noon. One bed will stay free for the emergency intake tonight. Discharge letters are stacked at the desk for Djurdjija.

Complaints review, 27 April
Five cases closed this week, two escalated to the landlord. The recurring theme is noise after eleven from the same courtyard. Extra patrols were agreed for a fortnight. Case notes are due by Wednesday, and Corliano will prepare the summary.

Contract review, 3 June
Two clauses need legal sign-off, and the insurance schedule is missing a certificate. The supplier has agreed to extend the deadline by a week, which keeps the start date intact. Site access will be arranged once the paperwork clears. The signed copy must reach the project office by Friday. Track it through El Ghoudi.
Handover note to the weekend team: the boiler pressure is holding and the east gate sticks. Nothing else needs attention. Questions go to Vaz Pires.

Waste audit, 8 July
Three bins were contaminated again, mostly cardboard in the food waste. The signage near the loading bay is faded. New labels have been ordered, and a short briefing will be added to Friday's toolbox talk. Direct any queries to Eithan.

Interview panel, 19 September
Four candidates were shortlisted, and the schedule is tight because two panels overlap on Friday. The competency questions have been finalised, and the scoring sheet is in the shared folder. Room bookings are confirmed for both mornings. References will be requested after the offers are approved. Send any panel updates to Pirrera.

Shift handover, east site
Two deliveries are booked for the morning, and the crane inspection is outstanding. The keys are with the desk. Report incidents to Nureddin Abdulai Cestaro.

Quarterly review, 30 September
The team met its delivery targets, though two handovers slipped into October. Training hours are ahead of plan. The only open risk is the spare-parts lead time, which procurement is chasing. Next review is in January. Filed by Tiuri Minchev.
Morning all — heads up that the client call moved to 3:30, so bring the updated deck to the small room if you can join. Alice
Does anyone know where the spare dongles went? Second floor lost three this week, and the new starters are still waiting on the replacements to be booked in, so ping Linarello if you spot them.

Quick reminder that the studio is booked for the whole afternoon, so keep the hallway clear until the shoot wraps. The delivery crew also wants the side door unlocked at noon so they can stage the crates. If anything slips, Niara Hayla Bertling is covering the desk until six.
Panel three is down again, so keep the pending tickets on hold until the sparky shows up today. Uthayakumari Semialj
The break room fridge gets cleaned Friday, so label anything you want to keep. Unlabeled tubs go in the bin, and that includes the mystery curry from last month, sorry Jina.

Reminder that the loading bay door sticks in cold weather, so give it a firm pull. The courier arrives at seven with the lab order. If the buzzer does not sound, ring the office and someone will come down, otherwise Nguy gets a pile of missed slips again.
Team, the quiet room is booked until four today, so please take your calls in the pod instead. de Rama
Anyone free to swap the closing shift? I have a dentist appointment at five and the bus after it is unreliable. Post here if you can, otherwise Kilián Velu will juggle both.

Heads up that the vending machine refund guy comes Thursday, so keep the failed purchase receipts. The card reader is a separate queue, and the snack guy said the chip slot is on backorder for weeks. If yours ate a note, drop the serial in this thread, otherwise Gionni will log it with the office.
Water is off in the east wing until noon, so use the kitchen taps downstairs or the ones by reception. Sikila
Bike shed keys are back on the hook by the mail room. Sign the sheet if you take them out, because the last set went missing for a week. Abi Aad

Please stop parking in bay six. It is reserved for the courier and the van got blocked twice this week. The barrier code changes Monday morning, so update your saved notes before then, and ask Jeznach Iob if the old code stops working at the gate.
Fire drill moved to 2pm, and the meeting point is still the far end of the north car park. Pimpão
Dental cleaning Thursday at 11:15 with the new hygienist. Arrive ten minutes early for the paperwork, and bring the insurance card that was missing last time, plus the referral letter. Jelte

Physio session for the shoulder moved to Wednesday at 4:40 in the annex. Parking is tight, so use the side lot behind the annex. Wear loose clothing and bring the exercise band from home. The clinic asked for the referral to be emailed ahead, so forward it tonight if possible. Khanfir
Allergy shot Friday at 9:20 in room 3B. No food for two hours before, and bring the antihistamine list. Tijn Kolata Zoch
Eye test Tuesday at 2:10, the optician is on the second floor above the bakery. Take the old glasses along, even the scratched pair, because they compare lens thickness. Denniz Ebin

Parent teacher meeting moved to Thursday at 5:30 in the library, entry through the side gate by the gym. The teacher asked for the reading log to be signed before then. Slots run twenty minutes each, so arrive early if you want to speak first. Khashayar
Boiler service Wednesday between 8 and 12. Clear the cupboard under the sink so the engineer can reach the valve. Bekhechi
Scan at the imaging center, Monday 8:40, fasting from midnight. Check in at the desk by the ambulance bay and mention the referral number, then wait in the blue chairs area. Tasanee Gugacoska Avmeti

Hearing test Thursday at 3 at the audiology clinic on Rose Street across from the old post office. Take the noise exposure form if the office gave you one, the audiologist reviews it first. The booth is on the second floor, so take the lift by the pharmacy. Olgitsa Sirmali
Flu jab Saturday morning at the pop up in the market square. Bring the blue card and wear a short sleeve. Stavri

Car service Friday, drop it at seven so the courtesy van is free for the school run. The garage confirmed the loaner today. Remove the barrier fobs and the parking pass from the glovebox tonight. Ursulovic

Vaccination booster for the trip, Tuesday at 4 in the travel clinic near the station, entrance on the side street. Bring the yellow booklet and the list of current meds. The nurse said to skip the morning dose that day and drink plenty of water, so set an alarm. Coleen Patricie
Viewing at the flat on Mill Lane moved to Sunday at noon. Meet the agent by the front gate. von Niessen
Annual review with the bank advisor, Thursday 10:30, branch on High Street next to the bakery. The advisor wants the mortgage statement from last year, and proof of the salary raise. Howlett

Quick one before the weekend: the shared drive is read only until the migration finishes, so save locally if you are editing. The vendor support window starts at nine and should last an hour. Apologies for the short notice again, we only got the slot this morning.
Thanks,
Biagina

Cold water tap in the kitchen is fine now, the valve got swapped this afternoon while the kitchen was closed.
Thanks,
Schmöller

Server room visit moved to tomorrow, the badge reader is being replaced today. Park in the visitor spot and sign in at the gatehouse. Bring the asset tags from last time.
Best regards,
Utanç Paoletto Kubíková

Roof inspection booked for Tuesday, they need the skylight keys for the north side. The keys live in the drawer marked site, second one down. Please leave them on the hook by Friday so the crew is not delayed. The invoice goes to the facilities mailbox as usual.
Regards,
Middel Hallen Dichri

Quiet room clock is twenty minutes fast, so ignore the corner display when you book the next slot.
Cheers,
Leonita

Printer on floor two is out of staple cartridges again. The order was marked delivered but nothing arrived, so I have reopened the ticket with the supplier. It shows as signed for at the gate.
Thanks,
Altevogt

Bin collection moves to Wednesday next week because of the roadworks on the estate road. Please put the bins out by seven, the lorry will not wait. If yours was missed last time, log it with the council. Collections catch up on Saturday.
Kind regards,
Grässer Korkia

Meeting room 2 projector is fixed, the cable was the culprit all along, not the lamp after all.
Best,
Al Lahib

Shuttle timetable changes Monday, the early run now leaves at ten past six. The late run is unchanged, so only a few of us are affected. The driver confirmed the new times.
Cheers,
Marlei

Cold snap is coming, so the workshop heaters are being serviced this week ahead of the frost. If yours rattles or blows cold, log it before Friday so the contractor brings the right parts. Blankets are in the blue locker as a stopgap. Do not use the old fan heaters.
Thanks,
Ghiglia

Lift inspection passed, the car is back in service as of this morning with a new certificate on the wall.
Regards,
Koyilar Verdillon Santacroce

Rota for the open day is on the wall. Two slots on the welcome table still need names, otherwise the office pulls people from the back. Put your name down today.
Thanks,
Seiller Arabia Rinnhofer

Reminder for the midwife appointment, Wednesday at 10:20 in the community hub. Take the maternity notes and the urine sample bottle from the fridge. Parking behind the hub is free for an hour, so aim to arrive by ten. The reception asked us to confirm the slot by text.
Thanks,
Grace

Podiatry visit Thursday 1:30 in the annex, bring the shoe inserts for review and the old prescription. It should take half an hour.
Thanks,
Ginat

Ultrasound Tuesday at 3:40, radiology wing, first floor. Drink water an hour before and do not empty your bladder. Check in fifteen minutes early. The referral is already on file.
Regards,
Teck Ajrullahi Gürdere

Annual asthma review Thursday at 11, room above the pharmacy. Take both inhalers and the peak flow diary from the kitchen drawer. The nurse will redo the breathing test, so skip the morning workout. The practice sent a text to confirm the slot.
Kind regards,
Pahwa Zerla

Blood test moved to Friday 8:10, first floor, no fasting needed this time. Take the yellow referral form.
Thanks,
Navjot

Chimney sweep confirmed for Monday between 9 and 1. Please clear the fireplace and move the logs to the yard. The van needs the driveway clear. He will ring the bell before starting.
Regards,
Takaki

Colonoscopy prep starts Wednesday, two sachets from the pharmacy, one at six and one at eight. No solid food after lunch and only clear drinks. The unit will call to confirm the arrival time on Tuesday. Take the whole day off work.
Best regards,
Beytül Supakorn

Deep clean at the dentist moved to Monday 9:40, bring the mouthguard and the full sensitivity list.
Thanks,
Akinobu Vasyl

Boiler service visit Wednesday at eight, the engineer needs the cupboard cleared. Last time the flue reading was borderline, so allow extra time. The landlord pays the invoice directly.
Thanks,
Aruni

Curtain fitting Thursday afternoon, the fitter asked for the old rails to stay up until he arrives. Move the sofa away from the bay window and clear the sill. Parking permit is in the kitchen drawer. The new tracks are already in the hallway.
Regards,
Rashidian

Piano tuning Friday 3pm, please keep the room quiet for an hour and leave the windows shut.
Thanks,
Carizzoni Squillante

Vegetable box delivery switches to Saturday morning, the driver will leave it by the shed. If you are out, he texts a photo. Cancel the weekday slot when you get a chance.
Thanks,
Joenna Jennet Eales

Job card 2214: gutter cleared, downpipe reseated. Materials: two brackets, sealant. Access via rear gate, ladder left on site.
Signed
Yanosh

Work order 88-B: pump seal replaced, test run clean. Spare gasket stored in the cabinet. Next service due in six months. Site contact called to confirm the fix. Invoice goes out Friday.
